welcome.body: Count your shawls, sell in seconds and send neat catalogues on WhatsApp. Everything stays on this phone.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: You can change this later in More.

shop.title: Your shop
shop.body: These details go on your catalogues and bills. Only the shop name is needed now.
shop.shopNameRequired: Type your shop name to continue.
shop.phoneHelper: Optional. Customers can call this number.
shop.addressHelper: Optional. One or two lines is enough.
shop.upiHelper: Optional. Printed on bills so customers can pay.
shop.upiInvalid: A UPI ID looks like name@bank. Check it or leave it empty.
shop.phoneInvalid: Check the phone number or leave it empty.

owner.title: Owner's WhatsApp
owner.body: Your sales reports go to this number. Ask the owner if you are not sure.
owner.bodyPrefilled: This number was set for you. Check it, then continue.
owner.label: Owner's WhatsApp number
owner.helper: Reports are sent here on WhatsApp.
owner.later: You can add it later in More, before you send your first report.
owner.invalid: Check the number or leave it empty for now.

lock.title: Lock the app?
lock.body: A PIN or your fingerprint keeps your prices and sales private if someone else picks up the phone.
lock.done: PIN is set. The app will ask for it when you open it.
lock.later: You can turn this on any time in More.

start.title: Ready to start
start.body: Add a real shawl now, or look around with sample products first.
start.addFirstHint: Take a photo, add colours and pieces
start.sampleHint: 12 shawls, a few customers and sales. Clear them with one tap later.
start.restore: Moving from another phone? Restore a backup
start.error: Could not finish setting up. Your details are saved. Try again.
